game_title: Divide Or Floor – Basalt Stair Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Mt. Pyre – Basalt Stair, a basalt column stairway: the forge smith must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split obsidian shards evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Basalt Stair: a basalt column stairway
core_gameplay_loop: In Basalt Stair, repeat each round: Pick / or // to split obsidian shards evenly among allies without leaving fractions. Each round, a new obsidian shards challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the share value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 220 points of obsidian shards by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 220, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 4 (applied tier): Divide Or Floor
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Basalt Stair'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how share changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Basalt Stair.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 220 within 39 seconds.
